agentUtterance.text: Pour diagnostiquer et résoudre le problème, veuillez lancer notre outil de Réparation Virtuelle via l'application MonBell. La Réparation Virtuelle est la première étape du dépannage et effectuera des tests en direct sur votre ligne. Si votre problème nécessite un support supplémentaire, les résultats des tests seront envoyés à un représentant du service client pour vous faire gagner du temps au téléphone. Je vais vous envoyer un SMS maintenant avec d'autres instructions. Est-ce que ça vous convient ?

playbookInput.precedingConversationSummary: The user contacted support about a service issue. After brief triage, the bot determines Virtual Repair may help and initiates the playbook to offer the self-serve option.

playbookOutput.executionSummary:
This interaction details a customer's persistent request for a live agent while the system attempts to direct them towards a self-serve Virtual Repair tool for internet troubleshooting.

The conversation begins with the agent recommending the Virtual Repair tool via the MyAccount app as the first step for diagnosing internet issues, highlighting its benefits (live tests, streamlined support). The agent then offers to send an SMS with instructions.

The customer repeatedly expresses their need for a live agent. The agent acknowledges this but consistently reiterates the importance and benefits of the Virtual Repair tool, explaining that it performs the same tests as agents and can save time. The agent offers alternatives, such as guiding the customer through the Virtual Repair process over the phone if they prefer not to use the app.

Despite the agent's explanations, the customer continues to insist on speaking with a "real human." The interaction concludes with a virgin_AQD (Agent Queue Driver) action, indicating that the customer will likely be transferred to a live agent.

This exchange demonstrates the system's attempt to:

Promote and guide users to self-troubleshoot using a Virtual Repair tool.

Explain the benefits and efficiency of self-service options.

Conversely, it highlights a customer's strong preference for direct human interaction, even when presented with self-service alternatives.
